about.text: mild, semi-firm British cow's milk cheese made in Derbyshire with a smooth, mellow texture and a buttery flavour.

sources.text: Wikipedia: ripens 1 to 6 months, softer body than Cheddar and does NOT go through cheddaring, so not the cheddared family. Natural or waxed rind. Sage Derby is a flavoured variety
